prompt: Deep within a dense pine forest, a family sets up camp around a crackling fire pit surrounded by smooth river stones. In the foreground, a father in a flannel shirt hammers a metal tent stake into the soft earth next to a green nylon tent. Beside him, a young girl in a yellow raincoat holds a flashlight beam directed at a map spread out on a folding table. To the right, a mother in a hiking vest pours hot coffee from a silver thermos into two ceramic mugs held by her teenage son wearing a beanie. A golden retriever sits patiently next to the son, looking up at the steaming mug with anticipation. Nearby, a stack of firewood is neatly arranged against a large oak tree trunk. A portable camping stove sits on a rock, with a blackened kettle whistling softly. In the background, tall pine trees filter the dappled sunlight, creating a serene atmosphere. The lighting is warm and golden, suggesting late afternoon. Smoke curls gently from the fire, adding depth to the air. This image is captured as a photorealistic photo with shallow depth of field blurring the distant trees while keeping the family interactions sharp and detailed.
